cc:Work.dc:title: Probability estimation against exact references
cc:Work.dc:description: Predicted probabilities versus exact event probabilities for Jev (A) and Luna (B), using the same 60 finite probability problems. The dashed diagonal is exact agreement, not a fitted line. Panel C shows mean absolute error in percentage points for three prespecified 20-case families. Intervals are exploratory 95% percentile bootstrap intervals from 10,000 resamples of case identities within each family, retaining model pairing. These intervals do not establish broad calibration or correct for multiple comparisons.
